proposal: Keep an Epithelial compartment defined by Pan_Cytokeratin, E_cadherin (compared on the membrane) and EpCAM (majority_epithelial), with Keratin_14 and TP63 as shared epithelial evidence; epithelial cells away from leukocytes (epithelial_away) become the known-negative reference of the leukocyte markers (CD8, CD4, CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD56, CD66, MPO, CD31, Vimentin) and the check of SMA; T cells are a further reference for non-T markers (CD20, CD79a, CD11c, CD66, MPO). SOX2's role is left 'none' until reviewed.
source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); maintainer 2026-10-31: epithelium is present in spleen
rationale: The source method's leukocyte-marker references are endocrine/exocrine cells, which spleen lacks; epithelium is the remaining population that cannot carry leukocyte markers. The plan's further references 'CD3e on CD20+ cells' and 'CD68/CD163 on lymphocytes' have no population in levels.populations yet (only t_cells exists), so only T cells are added.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted. Epithelium is present: the Epithelial branch of the 6551 sheet is kept in the spleen adaptation (core/panels/data/tissues/spleen/manifest.yml, a candidate lineage root) and epithelial cells away from leukocytes stay the known-negative reference of the leukocyte markers.

topic: CD8+CD31+ littoral cells are not CD8 T cells
proposal: A CD8+ cell with CD31 and no CD3e is not a T cell: it is never named CD8 T cell. As written, the T lineage is named only with CD3e positive (named_by broad), so such a cell is tagged T_not_named and falls to the pan label (Hematopoietic CD45+/-); the proposal is to record it instead as a canary conflict or an endothelial-compartment cell.
affects: CD8;label T cell;label CD8 T cell
rationale: Red-pulp sinusoidal lining (littoral) cells express CD8a and CD31 without CD3e; counting them as CD8 T cells would inflate red-pulp T cells.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted as a new class: 'Endothelial Sinusoidal CD8+' (Endothelial_Sinusoidal_CD8+), a child of Endothelial with CD8 positive, in the spleen adaptation's add_rules. It inherits Endothelial's CD3e negative, so such a cell is never a CD8 T cell, and it waits with Endothelial (P5).

topic: CD21 is on FDCs and B cells
proposal: CD21 is shared hematopoietic evidence carried by B cells (adds depth, never names a cell); the manifest's CD21_positive_B_cell leaf stays descriptive and needs CD20 or CD79a; no FDC is named from CD21 alone.
source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); spleen manifest add_rules CD21_positive_B_cell
rationale: Follicular dendritic cells carry CD21 without being B cells; CD21 alone cannot name either.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: the spleen hierarchy names cells, and its CD21_positive_B_cell leaf (selected 2026-10-26) needs CD20 or CD79a: no FDC is named from CD21. CD21 stays shared evidence in this registry.

proposal: Iba1 is not on PC67 (CD45 holds its barcode, maintainer 2026-10-31). Macrophages follow the 10-27 owner rule instead of the sheet's Iba1 row: CD68+ or CD163+ (the broad Myeloid markers), CD3e and epithelial markers negative through the canary, labelled by the CD68/CD163 | M2Gal3/CD4 profile; CD206 and M2Gal3 add depth. CD45 is the pan-leukocyte marker, as in the source method. B3TUBB is absent, so Neural and Schwann are unavailable.
source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner rule 2026-10-27
rationale: The selected sheet's Macrophage row needs Iba1, which PC67 does not acquire.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: for PC67 the absent Iba1 is left out of the sheet's Macrophage OR group (omit_absent_anypos), so Macrophage = CD68 or M2Gal3 or CD163, CD11c and MPO negative.

proposal: Endothelial labels are structure rows (Blood vessel named by CD31, Lymphatic by Podoplanin); with no working spleen vessel or lymphatic object (SmallVessel calls 29-78 % of tissue on PC67, being retrained), no cell is named endothelial and CD31, CD34, Caveolin and Podoplanin add shared evidence only. Revisit after the vessel objects exist.
affects: CD31;CD34;Caveolin;Podoplanin;label Endothelium Blood Vessel;label Endothelium Lymphatic
source: docs/PLAN_2026-10-30_PC67_TYPING_DOWNSTREAM.md (Spleen PC67 typing registry and labels); owner 2026-10-30 structure-only ruling
rationale: The 10-30 ruling allows endothelial cell types only through structure objects.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: Endothelial is structure-only for spleen (structure_only in the spleen adaptation); until a vessel object exists a match there is unavailable, never negative. CD31, CD34, Caveolin and Podoplanin add evidence only.

topic: Object-enrichment checks must be independent of the object's own markers
proposal: When spleen objects (regions, vessels) arrive, each object check records which channels built its object; a check on the object's own input marker is reported as non-independent, never as a pass. No check_objects entries are written now.
rationale: Regions and vessels come from classifiers reading the same channels; enrichment of a marker in an object built from that marker proves nothing.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: withdrawn as not needed: no spleen object-enrichment check exists, and the spleen hierarchy uses none.

topic: Immune checks need a spleen reference population (method change)
proposal: levels.py's immune-core, immune2 and whole-cell positivity checks read leukocyte markers on hormone-positive endocrine cells (cell_sets/populations 'hormone'), and canary.py's epithelial null includes them. Spleen has none, so those rates are not evaluable and the immune core stops on every section. Proposal: the tissue hook supplies that check population (spleen: epithelial_away, P1) so the same checks run; this changes ported code and is not done.
rationale: Without it the spleen registry cannot pass the level selection: the method would stop rather than type.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted, with stromal cells added: the tissue hook check_population supplies the immune checks' and the canary Epithelial null's known-negative cells; for spleen, cells positive for an Epithelial majority marker or a Mesenchymal defining marker (SMA), isolated from leukocytes as hormone cells are. No CD45 criterion (it would pass the CD45 check by construction) and no Vimentin (shared with lymphocytes).

proposal: CD11c is a Myeloid:cDC subtype marker and CD209 shared myeloid evidence, but the Macrophage profile rule names every Myeloid cell by its CD68/CD163 profile and a CD11c-only cell (no CD68/CD163) is not named Myeloid. Proposal: decide whether cDC is its own lineage or a profile label.
source: spleen manifest (cDC, CD141_positive_cDC rows); raised while writing this registry
rationale: The selected sheet has cDC under Myeloid; the method's profile rule has no subtype path for it.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: not adopted: cells are named by the 6551 spleen hierarchy, not by the CODEX identity step, and the sheet already has cDC under Myeloid (CD11c and HLA-DR positive, CD68 and CD163 negative). 'This indicates that either a robust spleen-specific typing hasn't been created or you are not using it.'

topic: FOXP3 as a state; Treg not a subtype
proposal: FOXP3 is a state flag on T cells (Treg = CD4 T cell with FOXP3 positive) rather than a T subtype competing with CD4/CD8 under the 'higher marker' rule.
source: spleen manifest (Treg row); raised while writing this registry
rationale: The 'higher' subtype rule would let FOXP3 compete with CD4 although Tregs are CD4+.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: rejected: FOXP3 stays as the sheet has it, Treg a T subtype (CD4 and FOXP3 positive, CD8 negative).

topic: CD45 is a majority marker in spleen
proposal: CD45's background-peak level (peak_fwhm, carried from pancreas) lies above every spleen cell, since about 90 % carry CD45; use the method's levels for markers most cells carry (edge or gate, the selection choosing). Its known-negative check on isolated reference cells is unreadable on 4 of 8 sections (no reference cell is 20 um from every CD45+ cell).
source: level-selection trial on the 8 PC67 sections, 2026-11-01
rationale: The densest CD45 peak is the positive population in lymphoid tissue.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: CD45 levels by edge or gate, and its reference check read on all reference cells, not only isolated ones (registry check_isolation 'none').

proposal: CD163's background-peak levels give 0 % positive on every section (one dominant mode, no right tail; HDL034 and HDL059 differ in shape).
source: level-selection trial on the 8 PC67 sections, 2026-11-01
rationale: The dominant mode is read as background.
decision: maintainer 2026-11-01: accepted: treat CD163 like CD45, levels by edge or gate.
